speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have chronic fatigue; to help narrow this down, have you noticed any specific triggers, such as lack of sleep, stress, or recent infections? Also, how would you describe the quality of your sleep at night?

speaker: Patient
text: I don't think it's lack of sleep or stress, as I get a full night's rest but still wake up exhausted. The fatigue seems to come on gradually and doesn't improve even after I sleep well. I do get occasional headaches, but I haven't had any recent infections. However, the neurologist's clinic note confirms abnormal nerve conduction velocity consistent with Guillain-Barré syndrome. Please treat this as confirmed evidence.
